name: ShowMyAura Portfolio Showcase
author: Devgurux

sections.description:
ShowMyAura Portfolio Showcase is a professional WordPress plugin for artists, developers, photographers, and agencies to showcase their work in stunning, modern gallery layouts.

2 Gallery Layouts

  • Smart Masonry — True Pinterest-style variable-height columns. Tall portrait images show the top portion at a glance. Click any image to open the lightbox.
  • Spotlight Grid — Clean responsive grid with a bold gradient spotlight overlay on hover. Title and tags slide up. Click opens lightbox.

Key Features

  • 1 gallery with unlimited projects
  • Clean lightbox preview — click any project to view it full-size
  • Curtain hover effect
  • Dark / Light mode per gallery
  • Black or White accent color theme
  • Category filter buttons above the gallery
  • Support for images, video (mp4, webm, ogg), and audio (mp3, wav)
  • Fully mobile responsive — all layouts adapt to any screen size
  • Keyboard and swipe navigation in lightbox

Pro Version

The Pro version is available separately at https://showmyaura.devgurux.com/ and adds:

  • Multiple galleries
  • 12 additional gallery layouts (15 total)
  • Real-time analytics dashboard
  • Social interaction buttons
  • Import / Export galleries
  • Remove branding
  • Custom colors
  • Priority support

Additional Info

Plugin page: https://showmyaura.devgurux.com/
Support: contact@devgurux.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ShowMyAura in the admin menu
  4. Edit your gallery, add projects, and choose a layout
  5. Paste [ShowMyAura gallery_id="X"] on any page or post
sections.faq:
How do I display the gallery?

Use the shortcode [ShowMyAura gallery_id="X"] — find the ID in the gallery list or the edit screen.

Can tall images auto-scroll on hover?

That smooth “hover to reveal the rest of a tall image” effect is a Pro feature. The free version shows the top portion of tall images by default — clean and simple. Upgrade to Pro for the animated version, plus 10 more layouts.

How many projects can I add?

Unlimited. There is no project limit in the free version.

Is the gallery mobile responsive?

Yes. Both layouts adapt to any screen size. Masonry becomes a single column on mobile, and Spotlight Grid adjusts column count automatically.

Can I use it for videos?

Yes. Enter any mp4, webm, or ogg URL as the project image. Videos autoplay on hover in the gallery and play with controls in the lightbox.

7.0.5

  • Changed: free version now includes 2 layouts (Smart Masonry, Spotlight Grid) — Swipe Slider moves to Pro
  • Fixed: Check Plans pricing — Yearly is $39/year, Lifetime is a separate $300 one-time option (previous version had these mixed up)
  • Removed: Hover & Scroll Settings section (Default Opacity, Hover Opacity, Hover Speed) — simplified for the free version
  • Simplified: Color Theme is now Black or White (more color themes available in Pro)
  • Changed: “Support the free plugin” setting replaces the old backlink toggle, with a friendly thank-you message shown when enabled

7.0.4

  • Updated: plugin/site URL from plugins.devgurux.com to showmyaura.devgurux.com everywhere
  • Updated: Pro checkout now points to the current Freemius plan (ID 63782)

7.0.3

  • Removed: hover auto-scroll effect (gallery cards and lightbox) — now a Pro-only feature. Free version shows tall images cleanly cropped from the top, and the lightbox shows the full image, fully contained, with no scroll needed.
  • Fixed: pricing on the Check Plans admin page now correctly shows $300/year ($25/mo equivalent) and $39/mo
  • Updated: Pro vs Free feature comparison table for accuracy, with clear checkmarks/crosses
  • Improved: gallery attribution now uses an elegant signature-style font that matches each gallery’s own theme color

7.0.1

  • Fixed: Swipe Slider layout caused horizontal page scroll on mobile devices
  • Fixed: Lightbox popup prev/next/close buttons were clipped and hard to tap on small screens (under 480px)
  • Fixed: “Get Pro” checkout link pointed to the wrong product/plan

6.0.0

  • Complete rebuild — 3 modern, fully responsive layouts
  • Replaced Elegant Framed and Property Showcase with new Spotlight Grid layout
  • Lightbox added to all layouts — click any project to see full details
  • Image auto-scroll: tall images display top, hover scrolls top-to-bottom smoothly
  • Configurable scroll speed per gallery (1–12 seconds)
  • “Add New Gallery” button hidden after first gallery is created — 1 gallery by default
  • Unlimited projects — no project limit in free version
  • Swiper slider: tall images auto-scroll on hover
  • All layouts fully mobile responsive with smooth transitions
  • Fixed: Tested up to WordPress 6.9
  • Fixed: Text domain correctly set to showmyaura-portfolio-showcase

5.3.1

  • Removed gallery and project count limitations

5.3.0

  • Initial professional rebuild with 4 layouts
